purpose: Determine whether one live known-child system ps can produce three actual EPERM task queries across the unchanged retry window. Compare with normal draining and pinned harness census.
syntheticDifference: 16384 repeated PID output columns and intentionally undrained stdout hold the exact child; neither is the actual native harness command or normal capture_output consumption.
ownership: A dedicated new-session worker retains its exact Popen ps child without a reaping wait or poll until release. For every target query, before/after sequence-bound parent acknowledgments use waitid(P_PID,WNOHANG|WEXITED|WNOWAIT) to prove the same exact child is not exit-pending. BSD birth/parent/group/status are supplemental; permission-denied identity remains unknown, never authorizes counters.
observation: Save every full sample and actual target task query. Append the query row before optional diagnostics and store task result before after-diagnostics. Before/after WNOWAIT acknowledgments and BSD queries add timing overhead, without changing production source, return values, retry count or 0.25-second spacing.
retryPolicy: Unchanged Runner.group_activity: up to three attempts, 0.25 seconds between incomplete attempts, no process exclusion or unavailable-to-zero conversion.
cleanup: Release stdout and independently reap exact ps child before returning the group sample to Runner; worker stays live for existing fail-closed/cleanup. This intentionally does not recreate signalling a live setuid ps child. Preserve group cleanup and exact leader reap separately.
controls: same command with normal immediate pipe drain
existing fixed native harness census preflight including real Mac unreaped-child guard

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONWARNINGS=error::ResourceWarning python -m unittest test_ps_lifetime test_guards -q
tests.skip: Real Mac unreaped-child test; required in Mac job
additionalCoverage: Non-reaping child-exit observation repeats and exact reap
Streaming overflow closes pipes and reaps exact owned child
Unavailable BSD identity allowed only with intact live parent acknowledgments; unknown counters stay null
Pipe-gated live child waitid check without scheduling-duration assumption
Contradictory known BSD birth tags fail coverage

evidenceLimit: A successful synthetic reproduction is a possible mechanism for that exact new child. It cannot identify the historical denied generation, explain browser exit, or verify native authentication. Missing three-observation/identity coverage remains failed/inconclusive.

waitidBinding.fallback: Darwin64 libSystem waitid; P_PID=1,WNOHANG=1,WEXITED=4,WNOWAIT=32,siginfo bytes104,pid offset12,status offset20,pointer bytes8
waitidBinding.gate: Real-child live check, two repeated exit-pending observations without reaping, exact exit7 reap, then ECHILD; mandatory in Mac job. No child counter permission is changed.

outerHelperProof: Bounded ps PID/PGID inventory must contain its exact unreaped Popen PID with the monitor PGID; no post-exit getpgid assumption.
